hero.title: Handball RefTest Management System
hero.subtitle: Create and manage handball rule reftests for referees and delegates of the Belgian Handball Federation

about.title: RefTest Management System
about.description: This application manages handball rules reftest sessions. Administrators can create reftest sessions in bulk for multiple users, send email invitations, track session progress and completion status, filter and sort sessions by various criteria, and view performance analytics including scores and completion rates. Reftests support {{count}} languages ({{languages}}).

bulk.title: Bulk Session Creation
bulk.description: Create reftest sessions for multiple users at once. Each session is assigned to a specific user with unique tracking capabilities.

management.title: Session Management
management.description: Track reftest sessions through their lifecycle: pending, in progress, completed, or expired. Filter and sort by status, date, score, or user email. Send invitations and manage all session actions.
